final: WITH g AS (SELECT tr.tradekind AS tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg GROUP BY tr.tradekind), s AS (SELECT tradekind, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share FROM g), av AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT s.tradekind, s.cnt AS count, s.share AS share, s.share - av.avg_share AS share_minus_avg FROM s, av WHERE av.avg_share IS NOT NULL AND s.share > av.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
